intent: Record the gate becoming a REUSABLE HAMMER: a second artifact (the AX-branded dogfood surface in app/) consumes the exact same gate primitive, unchanged, through a Cloudflare Worker, and renders its verdict as generative UI. This separates projected reuse from a REALIZED reuse link.
riskRationale: Reuse evidence, not a new safety claim. The risk is over-claiming 'realized' — guarded here by pointing at a concrete consuming file + a runtime check, and by keeping the gen-ui package itself listed as unproven (a local adapter stands in for the unresolvable @cloudflare/gen-ui).

constraints.detail: app/worker/index.ts imports { gate } from the package entry (../../src/index.js) and calls it directly — no fork, no copy. The hammer is reused, not reimplemented.

A runtime check posted a planted-leak GateInput to the Worker handler: status 200, verdict 'leak', 1 violation, and JSON.stringify(body).includes('alice.planted') === false (no raw secret crossed the wire).
verdict-to-ui.ts maps the Verdict to gen-ui UI-JSON via the documented model-JSX -> UI-JSON contract; renderUI(catalog) renders it into the AX catalog. The leak/verdict output IS the generative UI.
cd app && bun run build -> tsc --noEmit clean + vite build: 37 modules, dist/ emitted (index 148.26 kB / gzip 47.89 kB).

observations.detail: app/worker/index.ts (Cloudflare Worker) is the second consumer of the gate beyond the test suite.

The gen-ui rendering uses a LOCAL adapter mirroring @cloudflare/gen-ui's documented contract, because the real package 404s from the registry (findings.md Feedback #1). Reuse of OUR gate is realized; consumption of the real gen-ui package remains unproven.

actions.result: tsc clean; vite build 37 modules; dist/ with manifest/sw/offline/robots/sitemap present

actions.detail: Invoked worker.fetch() with a planted-leak POST body

assertions.detail: the dogfood runs the shipped gate, not a copy
no raw secret in the Worker response

mechanisms: If the gate folds into My AX as a reusable pre-ship gate (beside gateproof/mergegate), this Worker is the reference integration.
A deterministic edge referee that ToolPrivacyBench-style evals can call before an LLM judge.

links.note: The gate primitive is reused unchanged by the dogfood Worker. NOT a separate notebook citing the schema yet, so this is partial realization (in-repo reuse), recorded honestly as such.
